questions.q: True or false? Look back before you pass to your keeper.
questions.explain: Right, it's true. Looking back shows you if the way to the keeper is clear.
choiceExplanations: Right, it's true. Looking back shows you if the way to the keeper is clear.
If you don't look, a defender could steal the pass.

questions.q: Your keeper has the ball. What happens next?
options: Keeper passes back to the left teammate
Keeper passes to the right teammate
questions.explain: Yes. The right side is free, so the keeper passes there before the defender gets across.
choiceExplanations: The defender is still close on the left, so that pass is risky.
Dribbling out from goal is risky, because one mistake gives blue an easy goal.
Yes. The right side is free, so the keeper passes there before the defender gets across.

questions.q: A defender blocks the way to the keeper. Which pass is safe?
questions.explain: Yes. The defender blocks the keeper, so the free middle teammate is safer.
choiceExplanations: Yes. The defender blocks the keeper, so the free middle teammate is safer.
The defender is in that lane, so the pass could be stolen near goal.
